# FlutterProbe

> FlutterProbe is an end-to-end testing framework for Flutter apps. Tests are written in ProbeScript (.probe files,
> natural-language steps). A Go CLI (`probe`) sends commands to an on-device Dart agent (`flutter_probe_agent`);
> an MCP server (`probe-mcp`) exposes the same capabilities to AI agents.

Key facts for an AI agent:
- Install: `brew install alphawavesystems/tap/probe`; add `flutter_probe_agent` to the app and build with `--dart-define=PROBE_AGENT=true`.
- Run: `probe test tests/ -v --format json -o reports/results.json`.
- Failures look like `line N: <step>: rpc error -3200x: ... visible texts: [...], keys: [...]` — compare the visible texts/keys with the selector you used.
- Wait for each new screen (`wait until "Text" appears`) before tapping; use `#key` selectors; use `scroll down until "X" appears` for rows below the fold.
- OS dialogs (permission alerts, StoreKit sign-in) are not Flutter widgets: use `tap "Allow" in system dialog`, `dismiss system dialog`, `sign in sandbox tester`.
- Secrets: only through environment variables (`type "$NAME" into system field "Password"`); they are masked in output.
- AI features (local or hosted models) are optional and never required to run tests.

## Docs
- [Using FlutterProbe from AI agents](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/ai-agents/): the loop, reading failures, rules.
- [ProbeScript syntax](https://flutterprobe.dev/probescript/syntax/)
- [Dictionary of steps](https://flutterprobe.dev/probescript/dictionary/)
- [On-device agent](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/agent/): build flags, ports, tokens, RPC methods, troubleshooting.
- [System dialogs](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/system-dialogs/)
- [MCP server (21 tools)](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/mcp/)
- [CLI reference](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/cli-reference/)
- [AI and local models](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/ai/)
- [Configuration (probe.yaml)](https://flutterprobe.dev/advanced/configuration/)
